summary.title: Rule-layer triage: cut Halstead verdicts, fold runts, reframe info-theory onto the lexicon
summary.what: Three triage decisions captured as follow-ups + a design note (LEXICAL_ENTROPY.md). (1) Halstead volume/density not ported as standalone verdicts. (2) runts folds into the future package rule. (3) The information-theory signal is reframed: real Shannon entropy over the lexicon's identifier naming distribution, as an observation / cohesion battery input.
summary.why: Closes the remaining keep-or-cut triage from the rule-layer porting. Halstead Volume is the uniform/max-entropy proxy (N*log2(eta)); a count-of-bits-assuming-uniform is both a code-size proxy (correlated with the complexity family) and the wrong information measure. The traditional application is real Shannon H over an actual distribution, and the only component holding that distribution is the lexicon — over a different vocabulary (naming words, not program tokens), measuring naming diversity rather than size.

decisions.point: Port Halstead volume/density as verdicts, or cut?
decisions.chose: Cut as standalone verdicts; keep the measures on Structure ungated.
decisions.rationale: Volume is a code-size proxy correlated with cyclomatic/cognitive/sloc (already verdicts); difficulty/density is a weak standalone gate. The information-theory value is not in a structural verdict — it migrates to a lexicon naming-entropy measure.
rejected: Port volume/density as verdicts: redundant with the complexity family.

Replace Volume's uniform log2(eta) with true entropy over the operand distribution: only refines a code-size number; far less interesting than the naming-vocabulary angle, and still a measure not a verdict.

decisions.point: How to realize the information-theory signal?
decisions.chose: Shannon H + normalized evenness + perplexity on the lexicon TokenDistribution (over identifier word-tokens), surfaced in the vocabulary observation; normalized scope-entropy evaluated as a cohesion battery input.
decisions.rationale: Halstead Volume is uniform-max-entropy; real H = -sum p log p is the traditional measure, and the lexicon already computes the frequency distribution (Zipf alpha/R2/hapax). But the lexicon vocabulary is naming words (diversity), not program tokens (size) — a genuinely different signal. The distribution is a Zipf near-invariant, so global entropy is descriptive (observation), and the live signal is normalized LOCAL scope entropy vs the corpus norm, feeding the grab-bag/stutter cohesion battery.
rejected: A standalone entropy verdict: dishonest — the distribution is a near-invariant, no scalar threshold is defensible (emit-evidence-not-verdict).

decisions.chose: Keep, folded into the future package rule (not standalone).
decisions.rationale: Empty/near-empty package is minor package hygiene, not worth a standalone rule; is_runt() already exists at Package altitude and rides with the Martin/packages rule when it ports.
rejected: Cut runts entirely: the signal is mild but real package hygiene; folding preserves it cheaply.
Ship runts standalone: too thin to be its own rule.
